title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star: What Is a Star Really Made Of?

lines.text: Twinkle twinkle little star, how I wonder what you are!
lines.caps: *TWINKLE twinkle | little *STAR, how | I wonder *WHAT | you *ARE!

lines.text: Did you know real stars are NOT pointy shapes at all?
lines.caps: Did you *KNOW | real stars are *NOT | pointy *SHAPES at | *ALL?

lines.text: Up above the world so high, like a diamond in the sky!
lines.caps: Up above the *WORLD | so *HIGH, like | a *DIAMOND in | the *SKY!

lines.text: Each star is actually a giant glowing ball of super hot gas, just like our sun!
lines.caps: Each star is *ACTUALLY | a *GIANT glowing | ball of super *HOT | gas, just *LIKE our sun!

lines.text: They look like tiny dots only because they are trillions of miles away!
lines.caps: They look like *TINY | dots only *BECAUSE | they are *TRILLIONS | of miles *AWAY!

lines.text: When starlight passes through our wobbly air, it twinkles like magic!
lines.caps: When starlight *PASSES | through our *WOBBLY | air, it *TWINKLES | like *MAGIC!

lines.text: So next time you look up, you know you are seeing giant cosmic suns!
lines.caps: So next time you *LOOK | up, you *KNOW | you are seeing *GIANT | cosmic *SUNS!

lines.text: Now you know the real truth behind Twinkle Twinkle Little Star!
lines.caps: Now you *KNOW | the real *TRUTH | behind *TWINKLE Twinkle | Little *STAR!

lines.caps: *SING along and | *SUBSCRIBE to | *BABYBEATS Rhymo | for more fun *DISCOVERIES!
